notes.title: Update 1.1.0 Release Notes
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42300089/14fbf73281b2c3ab3f69e89526ff1e1e01b6e8b5.png"][/img][/p][h3]Update 1.1.0 has been released. [/h3][p]This update includes a wide variety of bug fixes, balance adjustments and quality-of-life improvements. Thank you to all who submitted feedback--your feedback makes a big difference! Suggested features and bugs reported by the community are marked with a ⭐.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]⭐ Stage Powerups now guide the player towards their location when within distance.[/p][/*][*][p]Style Points renamed to Positive Bonus. Getting a Positive Bonus will now trigger a visual effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Powerup Chain Positive Bonus now triggers starting at x30 instead of x20.[/p][/*][*][p]⭐ Reduced enemy count on certain waves on Foundation.[/p][/*][*][p]⭐ Reduced enemy count on certain waves on Turbine and adjusted enemy spawn timings.[/p][/*][*][p]⭐ Slightly increased powerup visuals and hitbox size.[/p][/*][*][p]Green Weapon-1 gravity effect can now derail enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced Red Burst-A burn damage (could previously have triggered a feedback loop causing infinite damage under certain circumstances).[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly decreased Yellow Burst-A damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased Orange Weapon-1 explosion damage and radius.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Blue Burst-A obstacle collision radius (hitting enemies remains unchanged but it is harder to accidentally collide with walls).[/p][/*][*][p]⭐ Fixed softlock that would occur when going out-of-bounds using Blue Burst-A.[/p][/*][*][p]⭐ Blue Burst-B now uses the correct energy color.[/p][/*][*][p]⭐ During boss spawn cutscenes, going out-of-bounds will now teleport the player onto the stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed homing projectile visual bug that would occur when an enemy is destroyed and preparing to shoot at the same time.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly changed Ether stage layout to reduce enemies getting stuck on the left side of the level.[/p][/*][*][p]⭐ Reduced Final Boss total health and adjusted health intervals.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Final Boss attack intervals.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Final Boss orange attack spawn radius and reduced explosion delay.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing red gate near the first wave in Final (to prevent players from advancing before completing the first wave).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Coming soon: more quality-of-life changes that didn't make it into this update, and more comprehensive changes to the finale sequence. Please stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]Eric·ZDW[/p]

notes.title: CHROMA+ELEKTRON Early Access Announcement: May 2nd 2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42300089/c55928c95b1c2b7d751c1913a37bf94af8a9c3f6.png[/img]

[b]Hello! Thank you very much for your patience up until now.[/b]

There haven't been many updates on this page but rest assured I'm still hard at work finishing the game. It seems more was needed to be done than expected. Hard to believe Next Fest was over a year ago...! 

[b]While the game is not quite ready for a full release, I'm pleased to announce that the game will be available in Early Access on May 2 2025.[/b]

The game is almost in a complete state but it requires more work for major bug fixes and polish. It is at a stage where gameplay elements are all present but are subject to change; player feedback would be extremely helpful and impactful, and new features could be added with enough interest! Please stay tuned for more information on how you can get involved in Early Access.

Early Access players can buy the game at a reduced price compared to the full version. Please note that if you want to try the game before purchasing, there is a demo that is available now and will continue to be available alongside Early Access.

[b]Thank you all so much again for your patience and support![/b]

eric.zdw

notes.title: CHROMA+ELEKTRON is coming to Steam Next Fest June 2023
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42300089/ed3dc76ff80c35cf39c09c2676110fa49ef0f27b.png[/img]

[b]I'm happy to announce that CHROMA+ELEKTRON will be coming to Steam Next Fest June 2023![/b] 

The demo will be available at the start of Next Fest, June 19th; you'll get to try the first few levels for yourself. I'll be livestreaming the game during Next Fest, so stay tuned for upcoming livestream dates.

A big thank you to everyone who's supported the game up until now. If you're interested in CHROMA+ELEKTRON and haven't wishlisted it already, consider wishlisting to stay up to date.

eric.zdw
